purpose: Define reusable plot-shape families that cube recipes can reference instead of privately owning math families.

field_contract.parameter_fields: Named inputs needed to instantiate the shape family.
field_contract.geometry_outputs: Geometry output categories the shape can produce.
field_contract.semantic_outputs: Semantic output categories the shape can support after role mapping.
field_contract.generation_uses: Building, object, ornament, AI-affordance, and motion use cases.
field_contract.tileability: Whether the shape can repeat, tile, wrap, or remain local.
field_contract.connector_relevance: How this shape can connect to cube faces, sockets, paths, or regions.
field_contract.animation_relevance: How this shape may later support motion or deformation.
field_contract.non_claims: Explicit non-claims preventing production, fabrication, structural, AI correctness, Gym, or Museum approval.
